entities.summary: Cliff Matthews is an American football coach and former defensive lineman. He most recently served as the co-defensive coordinator and defensive line coach for Reinhardt University, positions he held in 2024. He was selected by the Atlanta Falcons in the seventh round of the 2011 NFL draft. He played college football at South Carolina.
